LanguageData.HE_Nord_Helm.label: spangenhelm
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Helm.description: A rounded iron helmet of riveted plates with a broad nose guard and spectacle-shaped eye guards.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Byrnie.label: byrnie
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Byrnie.description: A knee-length shirt of riveted iron rings over a padded tunic. Heavy, but it stops most cuts.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FurCloak.label: fur cloak
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FurCloak.description: A heavy cloak of thick pelts fastened with a bronze brooch. Nothing keeps out the northern wind better.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Tunic.label: wool tunic
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Tunic.description: A thick woollen tunic with woven bands at the cuffs and hem. Warm, sturdy and itchy.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Circlet.label: jarl's circlet
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Circlet.description: A plain silver band worked with knotwork and set with one red stone. A jarl needs no grander crown: his word at the Thing is enough.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FieldCoat.label: Nordic greatcoat
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FieldCoat.description: A heavy grey-blue greatcoat with a fur collar and two rows of pewter buttons. Made for winters that do not end.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_SteelHelmet.label: Nordic steel helmet
LanguageData.HE_Nord_SteelHelmet.description: A deep steel helmet that flares over the neck, with a raised nasal ridge and a black raven painted on the side.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FieldUniform.label: Nordic field uniform
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FieldUniform.description: A long field-grey tunic with a dark green collar, pewter buttons and deep skirt pockets. Warm in the snow.
